# Ship Thesis

> We build AI-powered mobile apps and SaaS products for founders. A working build on your phone every week, fixed-scope milestones, and code you own.

## Overview
Ship Thesis is an app and SaaS development studio specializing in turning startup ideas into production-ready software. We engineer cross-platform Flutter mobile apps, Next.js web platforms, and integrate intelligent AI capabilities.

## Dedicated Services
- [MVP Development for Startups](https://www.shipthesis.com/mvp-development): Fixed 3-4 week MVP delivery with weekly working builds, fixed-price milestones, and 100% IP ownership.
- [SaaS MVP Development](https://www.shipthesis.com/saas-development): Production-grade Next.js SaaS platforms with multi-tenant PostgreSQL (RLS), Stripe/Razorpay subscriptions, and automated background jobs.
- [Flutter App Development](https://www.shipthesis.com/flutter-app-development): 60fps iOS and Android mobile apps from a single codebase, offline-first SQLite persistence, and App Store submission.
- [Applied AI Product Engineering](https://www.shipthesis.com/ai-product-development): Deterministic LLM integrations, structured schema enforcement, hybrid RAG retrieval, and hallucination guardrails.

## Case Studies
- [EHS Training Platform](https://www.shipthesis.com/work/safety-training-platform): Live custom training and webinar LMS with Zoom API and Supabase.
- [Poststeady](https://www.shipthesis.com/work/poststeady): Automated client reporting SaaS turning analytics CSVs into branded insights.
- [ChromaLayer](https://www.shipthesis.com/work/chromalayer): Native Windows system utility for advanced screen color and temperature control.
- [Assess Yourself](https://www.shipthesis.com/work/assess-yourself): Offline-first Flutter mobile test engine with crash-resilient session recovery.

## Engagement Model
- Fixed-Scope Milestones: 30% / 40% / 30% payment schedule tied to verified software delivery. No surprise hourly rates.
- Weekly Working Builds: Test progress directly on your phone or staging domain every week.
- 100% Code Ownership: Private git repositories created under your GitHub organization. You own all IP from day one.
